name: Thunderhorn Cleansing Totem
summary: Mull Thunderhorn prepares the Thunderhorn Cleansing Totem in Bloodhoof Village. Ancestral magic in the totem is meant to purify the Thunderhorn Water Well.

sections.title: Purifying the Thunderhorn Well
sections.body: Mull Thunderhorn entrusts a prepared totem to travelers in Bloodhoof Village. They carry it north to the Thunderhorn clan's sacred spring, where foul agents have tainted the water. The ancestral wells dug by the tauren tribes nourish their herds and hunting grounds. Through ritual invocation, the totem calms the water's disturbed spirits and cleanses the site.

faq.q: What is the purpose of the Thunderhorn Cleansing Totem?
faq.answer: The totem is prepared to cleanse the corrupted Thunderhorn Water Well north of Bloodhoof Village. Its use drives away the foul influence poisoning the well and pleases the ancestral spirits guarding it.
Mull Thunderhorn crafts and bestows the totem. The elder lives in Bloodhoof Village, watches over the health of the land, and communicates with the ancestors.

faq.q: Where must the totem be used?
aliases: where do i use the totem
faq.answer: Use the totem at the Thunderhorn Water Well, north of Bloodhoof Village in central Mulgore.

faq.q: What happens after the ritual is performed?
faq.answer: Cleansing the well brings peace to the Thunderhorn clan's ancestral spirits. Mull Thunderhorn dreams of their gratitude, praise, and ancestral gifts for the one who purified their grounds.

angles.text: As a tauren, you have a sacred duty to purify ancestral wells for the Earth Mother and the clan ancestors who watch over Mulgore.
As a shaman, you know cleansing totems can pacify disturbed nature spirits and restore balance where elemental energies have turned bitter.
